verdict.rationale: Render's own marketing copy says it offers fully-managed databases with point-in-time recovery, read replicas, and high availability, and its docs mention datastores with advanced recovery features. However, this is a single marketing-level line that never names Postgres and has no in-depth docs or hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: explicit Postgres engine confirmation, detailed docs on PITR, replica and HA configuration and their limits, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can provision a fully-managed Postgres database with point-in-time recovery, replicas, and high availability

citations.quote: Deploy fully-managed databases with point-in-time recovery, read replicas, and high availability.
